blocks.text: The Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) reminded the “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0” production team to “exercise greater prudence” following their meeting on the complaints against the reality show. The meeting was held on Thursday, Nov. 26, with MTRCB chair and CEO Lala Sotto urging “PBB’s” management to be more mindful of its content as well as to closely review its upcoming episodes. “We heard the complaints of our viewing public and acted on them without delay. These reports helped us know what we should look into,” Sotto said, citing the over 2,900 complaints from viewers and the […]...
